entities.summary: Neftçi Arena, formerly known as Bakcell Arena, is a football-specific stadium located in the 8th Kilometer district of Nizami raion, Baku, Azerbaijan. The stadium has a capacity of 11,000 spectators and serves as the home ground of Azerbaijan Premier League club Neftçi PFK. It also serves as an occasional venue for the Azerbaijan national football team. The stadium was nominated for StadiumDB's Stadium of the Year award in 2012.
